meta.name: google-cloud-waf-security
meta.description: Generates security-focused guidance for Google Cloud workloads based on the design principles and recommendations in the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework (WAF). Use this skill to evaluate a workload, identify security requirements, and provide actionable recommendations for IAM, network security, data protection, and operational security.

copy.tagline: 评估云工作负载安全并提供加固建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在 Google Cloud 上运行工作负载并需要安全加固指导。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate cloud workload security and provide hardening recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run workloads on Google Cloud and need security hardening guidance.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据 Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework 的安全支柱，评估你的工作负载，并提供关于 IAM、网络安全、数据保护和运营安全的具体建议。
howto.when: 当你询问如何提升 Google Cloud 工作负载的安全性，或要求评估现有架构是否符合安全最佳实践时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估我的 Google Cloud 项目安全性。
say.note: Claude 会询问你的安全需求并给出建议。

say.text: 如何为我的 GKE 集群实施零信任？
say.note: Claude 会提供基于 WAF 的零信任指导。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can evaluate your workload based on the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework security pillar and provide actionable recommendations for IAM, network security, data protection, and operational security.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about improving security for Google Cloud workloads or request an evaluation against security best practices.

say_en.text: Evaluate the security of my Google Cloud project.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about your security needs and provide recommendations.

say_en.text: How do I implement zero trust for my GKE cluster?
say_en.note: Claude will provide guidance based on the WAF security pillar.
